verdict.rationale: Lithic's docs show the platform absorbing much of the regulatory/program burden (KYC bypass for pre-approved partners, network-level dispute filing, program/account/card-level authorization rules, sandbox to test end-to-end before going live), which supports the 'don't become a bank' promise, but there is no explicit mention of BIN sponsorship or network membership terms, and no documented signup-to-first-live-card timeline or onboarding SLA. Community comments (e.g., HN) reference reduced time/cost versus building in-house but also flag that compliance/legal remains a headache, adding caveats rather than confirming a documented timeline. missing for 10: explicit BIN sponsorship/network membership documentation, a stated or benchmarked signup-to-first-card timeframe, and independent verification of onboarding speed.
